pages.title: The Fengyuan Earth Abyss
pages.text: This page follows secret_realms.json#diyuan and the Tianyuan/Fengyuan corpus. The Earth Abyss is a high-level secret realm beneath Fengyuan Continent in the Spirit Realm. Its authored requirements are Void Refinement or higher plus Tianyuan merit or a Fengyuan permit, tied to diyuan_access_token.

pages.title: Current Entrance
pages.text: The current version provides seeking_immortals:diyuan_permit, which the Earth Abyss entrance consumes on the server. The realm also has the no_fly rule: all flight sources are suppressed unless the player is in Creative or Spectator mode.

pages.title: Six-Layer Structure
pages.text: The corpus divides exploration into six layers: the Rift Mouth, Shallow Veins, Middle Galleries, Deep Pressure Zone, Earth Abyss Core, and Ancient Vein Node. Hazards include turbulent spiritual qi, crushing-pressure debuffs, high-tier demon beasts, and spatial folds.

pages.title: Rewards and Future Work
pages.text: Planned rewards include ancient beast cores, earth-ridge roots, spatial-law fragments, Earth Abyss chests, spirit-vein fragments, ancient beast materials, Earth Abyss core crystals, and pressure-resistance charms. Only part of the entrance, no-fly, and pressure-resistance chain is implemented; layered exploration, pressure damage, beasts, gathering, and quests remain future work.
